routes.name: Citizenship by Investment: National Transformation Fund contribution
routes.summary: Get Grenadian citizenship by making a one-time contribution to the National Transformation Fund. Paid through an Authorised Local Agent. No residency needed before or after.

investment.note: Single applicant. 200,000 USD for main applicant plus spouse or a family of four. Over four people adds 25,000 USD for each dependant after the third.

other: Main applicant must be in good health and have legally sourced funds.
Applications can be denied for false info, a serious conviction, a criminal investigation, or a security risk.
Applicants refused a visa by a visa-free partner country can be denied.
Must apply through an Authorised Local Agent.

documents: Medical certificate for main applicant and applying family

fees.label: Due diligence, main or single applicant
Due diligence, each other applicant aged 17+

citizenship.note: No residency requirement. Citizenship can extend to spouse, dependent children and dependent parents.

routes.name: Citizenship by Investment: Approved real estate project
routes.summary: Get Grenadian citizenship by investing in a government-approved project like a hotel, resort or villa. Done through an Authorised Local Agent.

other: Fee page lists 350,000 USD and 220,000 USD for this route without saying when each applies. Confirm with an Authorised Local Agent or the CBI Unit.
Minimum holding period not stated on pages read.
Main applicant must be in good health and have legally sourced funds.

fees.label: Government fee, single, couple or up to four people
Due diligence, main or single applicant

routes.name: Visitor entry and visa
routes.summary: Visa rules depend on your citizenship. Check the official Grenada visa requirements list. Cruise passengers staying under 24 hours need no visa.

other: Country-by-country list is in a PDF (Feb 2021) not read here, so which nationalities are visa-free is unconfirmed.
Visa holders cannot work without Ministry of Labour permission.

Visa via Beijing embassy, multiple entry

routes.processing: Embassy in Beijing says about 10 business days.
